I just checked again and nothing has changed since a few minutes ago. Your Magic M. 40T on order Shop···· is paid but hasn't shipped. It's still waiting on stock at our Tennessee warehouse.

It was meant to ship November 14, so it's late, and I'm sorry we didn't write to you about it. I don't have a new ship date to give you yet. I've asked the team for one. They're offline right now and will pick this up today at 10am ET. The answer will come to your email, and your tracking will go there too once the miner ships.
